title: Tamper-proof puzzle games in open briefcase, Utah ranch experiment (12/08/2009)
description: Color photo of an open briefcase lined with black foam holding wooden and metal brain-teaser puzzles: a jointed wooden block snake, six wooden boat-shaped pieces, an octagonal coin-like disc, and several wire ring and loop puzzles; a timestamp reads "12/08/2009 14:31." Text under the heading "Tamper-Proof Games Located on the Ranch" explains that BAASS assembles, photographs and locks such games in briefcases in Las Vegas before transporting them to the Utah ranch.
